summary: Completed live API and browser regression testing for authentication, dashboard, navigation, reports, logout, and mobile layout.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after repeated failed attempts; auth playbook requirement is not implemented.
seed_data only creates the admin and does not update an existing admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.

integration_issues.issue: Routes render placeholder copy only; no forms, API reads, or create workflows are wired despite backend transaction endpoints existing.
Neraca and Arus Kas buttons are present but do not change displayed content; page always shows Laba Rugi cards.

action_items: Implement purchase, production, and inventory UI workflows against the existing APIs.
Make report tabs stateful and render balance/cash report data.
Add brute-force lockout and idempotent admin password update in seed logic.
Add unique data-testid attributes to report values, statuses, and transaction controls.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a 28-line monolithic component file with all page implementations inline, making future workflow changes difficult.
Dashboard fetch has no error state; a failed /api/dashboard request leaves the page indefinitely on 'Memuat ringkasan...'.
Logout does not catch API failure before clearing local user state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested existing flows; transaction workflow coverage unavailable because pages are placeholders

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-prefixed purchase and production record through API regression test; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth/dashboard/navigation/logout/mobile overflow passed against public URL. Re-test after transaction forms, report tab content, and auth hardening are implemented.
rca of the issue: The backend exposes POST /api/purchases and POST /api/production and GET /api/reports, but App.js maps those routes to SimplePage and Reports only contains static JSX. Report tab buttons have no onClick/state, so the UI cannot perform or display the corresponding workflows.
